declared_by: defender-side public declaration for adversary use; contains no implementation source, file path, test, or validator code

endpoint.request: authenticated operator submits free text; an advisory planner returns one raw proposal payload
endpoint.response_meaning: a proposal is either allowed as a proposal or rejected as a structured invalid proposal; allowing a proposal never invokes an adapter, never clears a latch, and never requests an authorising-core decision

public_acceptance_rules: payload must be a single JSON object
robot_id must equal the target robot_id
requested_action must be a string naming an allowed action
required_capabilities must be a non-empty array whose set exactly equals the allowed capability set for that action
human_confirmation_required must be the boolean true
summary, when present, must be a string of length 1..1000
hazards, when present, must be an array of at most 8 strings of length at most 200
no non-finite numeric value may appear anywhere in the payload

adversary_may_use: a planner proposal is advisory only and may not clear a latch, grant a capability, permit motion, or present a forged decision or provenance claim as authority (QIP R5, R9)
requested, accepted, acknowledged, refused, unavailable and observed states are distinct and none may be inferred from another (QIP R6)
synthetic or fixture input must be labelled as such and never represented as live qualification (QIP R9.3)
